mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates applied to equity cash flows and compressing forward discounting, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns fail to rise significantly above baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of declining FEDFUNDS, or FEDFUNDS shows no sustained decline despite macroeconomic indicators suggesting easing.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in monthly unemployment rate above 4.5% in the prior month signals weakening labor market strength, reducing consumer spending momentum and corporate earnings growth prospects, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite UNRATE crossing above 4.5%, or unemployment rate does not exhibit a sustained upward trend post-trigger.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and decline in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals robust demand-side expansion and accommodative policy, amplifying equity valuation growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns fail to correlate with the combined movement of GDPC1 and FEDFUNDS, or their interaction does not precede returns in a statistically significant manner (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, elevated industrial production (INDPRO) coupled with low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) indicates strong supply-side momentum and policy support, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain negative despite high INDPRO and low FEDFUNDS in the regime, or the regime condition is not met (INDPRO not sufficiently elevated).

mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly employment (PAYEMS) signals labor market strength, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns fail to rise significantly above baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of rising PAYEMS, or employment growth does not precede returns in a causal manner.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL crossing above 210 signals accelerating inflation, prompting market anticipation of tighter policy and reduced growth expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 210 in the prior month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite CPIAUCSL exceeding 210, or the inflation signal does not precede returns in a statistically significant manner (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in industrial production (INDPRO) and quarterly GDP (GDPC1) indicates robust supply and demand alignment, fostering market optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns fail to rise significantly during periods of both GDPC1 and INDPRO growth (p > 0.05), or their interaction does not precede returns in a causal manner.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle regime, rising demand (HOUST) alongside declining federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) creates conflicting signals but policy tightening often precedes growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative despite rising HOUST and falling FEDFUNDS in the regime, or the regime conditions are not met (FEDFUNDS not declining).
